projects.title: LeetRepo
projects.summary: Archives accepted LeetCode solutions on GitHub and turns them into a study system.
projects.description: Captures submissions, organizes code and READMEs, tracks progress, and supports spaced-repetition review.
highlights: Syncs accepted solutions to GitHub automatically
Organizes problems, metadata, and attempt history
Offers analytics and optional AI interview notes

projects.title: Apulza AI Website
projects.summary: A responsive marketing site for an AI student-support platform with 1,000+ monthly visitors.
projects.description: A React and TypeScript SPA with custom CSS, Cloudflare hosting, and Formspree contact forms.
highlights: Serves 1,000+ monthly visitors
Custom responsive UI built without a component library
Cloudflare deployment with Formspree contact forms

projects.title: FeelWellFurniture
projects.summary: A responsive e-commerce site for a local furniture business.
projects.description: A React storefront with a product catalog, detailed product pages, themes, and responsive interactions.
highlights: Responsive catalog and product pages
Dark and light themes
Animated UI with Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion

projects.title: StudySearcher
projects.summary: Matches students by classes and availability, with profiles and messaging.
projects.description: A full-stack app with a PostgreSQL data model, WebSocket chat, and authentication.
highlights: Matches students by classes, availability, and profile
Migrated data from MongoDB to PostgreSQL
Added WebSocket messaging, authentication, and profiles

projects.title: Portly
projects.summary: A TCP proxy that handles each bidirectional connection independently.
projects.description: Handles abrupt disconnects cleanly and supports configurable listen and target addresses.
highlights: Runs each connection in its own goroutine
Pipes traffic both ways with io.Copy
Prevents goroutine leaks during disconnects

projects.title: autograd_engine
projects.summary: A scalar autograd engine with reverse-mode differentiation.
projects.description: Records computation graphs, calculates gradients, and trains a small neural network on make_moons.
highlights: Supports core operations with a custom Value type
Computes gradients with a topological backward pass
Trains MLPs using MSE and Armijo line search

projects.title: Personal Portfolio
projects.summary: A responsive portfolio for software projects and experience.
projects.description: A React site with reusable components and JSON-managed content.
highlights: Reusable project and experience cards
JSON-based content management
Deployment through GitHub Pages

projects.title: Three-Node Homelab
projects.summary: A three-node Proxmox cluster hosting Docker services over LVM.
projects.description: Managed with Bash on Debian, with custom networking and VPN overlays.
highlights: Runs Docker Compose services, including Jellyfin
Automates system administration with Bash
